sloka: प्रतिगृह्य ततो वीरो मणिरत्नमनुत्तमम् ।अङ्गुल्या योजयामास न ह्यस्य प्राभवद्भुजः ।।। ५.३८.७०।।।।
transliteration: pratigṛhya tato vīro maṇiratnamanuttamam ।aṅgulyā yojayāmāsa na hyasya prābhavadbhujaḥ ।।। 5.38.70।।।।

translations.english: Then Hanuman, taking the extraordinary jewel and placed it on his finger as it was not fitting to his arm.
